dogecoin.text: @elonmusk Congratulations on an amazing achievement. You should be very proud of yourself and your team. #SpaceX #Tesla #Dogecoin

@elonmusk Why did you say dogecoin was a hustle? I know you were trying to be funny, but the crypto was crushed after that. Please clarify. Also Doge is being shorted. Can you fight that the same way you did when they were shorting TSLA for so long.
@itsALLrisky #Bitcoin uses way too much electricity in mining and for transactions. #dogecoin is the better long term cryptocurrency.

@btchodle @itsALLrisky @elonmusk I went in pretty heavy on dogecoin. Their are so many out there, but I like that transaction speeds are fast and it uses far less electricity than Bitcoin. I’d like to see @elonmusk create a giant solar project that makes dogecoin net 0 on fossil fuel usage.

@DetmanCurt @elonmusk Same here. Elon did not tell anyone to invest their life savings. He believes in crypto. He believes in dogecoin, and cryptocurrency is volatile. Bitcoin has weathered these swings and so will Doge. I think it’s a buying opportunity for those who can.
@Wizard_Predicts @elonmusk Crypto market getting crushed. I hope this is only temporary. Went a bit heavy on #Dogecoin
@elonmusk @dogecoin_devs Doge needs to limit the amount of dogecoin that can be mined. Many people are uncomfortable with the idea that unlike Bitcoin, Doge doesn’t have a supply cap.
@btchodle I bought some additional dogecoin when it dipped to $.25.
@ShanLea4 @elonmusk @dogecoin_devs It’s not a supply cap if you add 9 billion in coins each year.
